name: next-starter
summary: Next.js starter template with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, NextAuth, Stripe, Drizzle and testing preconfigured.
description: A batteries-included Next.js 16 template built with React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS 4 and shadcn/ui components. It ships authentication with NextAuth, Stripe payments, Drizzle ORM on Neon Postgres, Zod validation, dark mode, i18n and a sitemap and robots.txt setup. Biome, Husky, Jest, React Testing Library and Playwright come configured for linting, formatting and testing.
contains: Next.js 16 template with React 19, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS 4
shadcn/ui components, Lucide icons and dark mode via next-themes
Stripe payments, Drizzle ORM on Neon Postgres, Zod validation
i18n with next-intl, sitemap and robots.txt
Jest, React Testing Library, Playwright, Biome and Husky preconfigured
T3-env environment variables and GitHub Actions linting
